action: DESCENTE advises ignoring and deleting suspicious emails or SMS without clicking links or opening attachments; fitfit advises resetting the password through its official site and says it will not send reset links unless the user starts the reset.
date_note: DESCENTE's notice dates the unauthorized access to the early to late morning of 23 November; fitfit's notice says late on 22 November.

2026年11月22日（日）深夜、委託先のシステムに第三者による不正アクセスが行われました。

exec: Customer details at Japanese online shops run by Jade Group may have leaked, according to DESCENTE and fitfit.
geo_basis: country of the organisation; no city stated in the pages read
org: Jade Group Co., Ltd. (operator of the e-commerce systems for DESCENTE and fitfit)
plain: Brands DESCENTE and fitfit say an outside party got into the online shop system run by their contractor Jade Group. Customer details may have leaked; both say card data was not involved.
summary: DESCENTE's notice of 24 November says traces of external unauthorized access were confirmed on the system of Jade Group, which operates DESCENTE STORE, in the early to late morning of 23 November; CLUB DESCENTE member data may have leaked. fitfit's notice says a third party accessed its contractor Jade Group's system late on 22 November, and that encrypted passwords may be affected. Both say card data was not involved; neither gives a number of people.
title: Jade Group e-commerce system breach: DESCENTE and fitfit say customer data may have leaked

validation.note: Two brands' own notices (DESCENTE, fitfit) state the access to Jade Group's system; both are primary pages. The Security Measures Lab roundup was read for context only. Jade Group's own statement was not read.
